mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 3.0% compresses equity valuations by raising discount rates applied to future cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase above 3.5% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 3.5, or Rank IC falls below 0.01 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 45% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.025.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0) signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A high CPI index level (CPIAUCSL > 290) indicates persistent inflation that increases monetary policy tightening risk, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 290, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate increase above 3.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that raises equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.5, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.015.

mechanism_narrative: Declining retail sales (RSAFS < 680000) signals retail sector weakness that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS < 680000, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.
